input.summary:
Implemented a Task Management API per the C4 specification using Node.js built-in modules and TypeScript. Components include:
- EventBus (src/event-bus.ts): In-memory pub/sub.
- Services (each in its own file under src/services): UserService, ProjectService, TaskService (publishes task.assigned and task.statusChanged), CommentService (publishes comment.added), NotificationService (subscribes to events and stores notifications).
- API Router (src/router.ts): Single HTTP entry point with routes for users, projects, tasks, comments, and notifications. It enriches comment.added events with assigneeId and republishes them to enable notifications without direct service-to-service calls.
- Main (src/main.ts): Wires up dependencies and starts the server.
- Demo (src/demo.ts): Starts a server on port 3001 and demonstrates full flow: create users, create project, add members, create tasks, assign, change status, add comments, and retrieve/mark notifications.
- tsconfig.json configured with Node types.
Compilation verified via `npx tsc --noEmit`.
